summary: Rerun direct BiliDili mainbody realverify after Alembic commit 1f141c8 repaired coverage writes from accepted persisted source refs. This is the next Phase VERIFY gate for finding#1 and the remaining direct end-to-end checks.

targetTasks.summary: Read parent AGENTS.md, the active state root, Test repository rules, and the controller review evidence `evidence/fix-main-source-ref-backed-coverage-cells-controller-review.md`. Declare Test window/repository identity. Use the real BiliDili test project directly, per user authorization; do not create a loyal-copy substitute for acceptance. Use the already configured provider split: DeepSeek for generation/planning, Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b for embeddings. Consume latest accepted local product repos, including Alembic commit `1f141c847c4140233f9c9796e97db2579949c60a`; verify live dist/runtime actually contains that Alembic repair before running. Clean prior BiliDili Alembic test/generated data enough to avoid false positive carryover, while preserving the BiliDili source project. Run the direct mainbody lifecycle verification chain again: plan/coldStart -> deepMining -> moduleMining -> evolution/maintenance -> anti-fabrication rejection probe as needed by the demand design. Primary gate: after deepMining, direct DB SQL must show coverage_ledger rows with `covered_count > 0` and non-empty `covered_source_refs`; include before/after counts for knowledge_entries, recipe_source_refs, coverage_ledger, deep_mining_rounds, semantic_memories, plus sample coverage rows proving source refs overlap real BiliDili files. Continue remaining Phase VERIFY checks only after the coverage gate passes: deep_mining_rounds should show real multi-round progress/stop reason, moduleMining should add knowledge_entries, evolution sweep should execute/promote or route maintenance state as designed, and intentionally bad/no-source recipe submission must be rejected by quality/anti-fabrication gates. Do not relax gates, do not accept replica-only evidence, and do not patch product code in Test. If blocked, stop with the exact failing command/API/log/SQL and classify the owning repo. Backfill a TargetResultEnvelope with raw evidence paths, command outputs, DB SQL summaries, provider/runtime config, BiliDili HEAD, product repo HEADs, and pass/fail for each verification step.
